title: Presheaf extension from a field preserves monomorphisms
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X a topological space, R a sheaf of possibly noncommutative rings, and alpha:k -> R(X). The identity-site presheaf pullback for the map [def-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-ring-map], whose existence is [lem-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-pullback-exists], preserves monomorphisms of constant-k module presheaves, in every carrier universe Type(max u v). This statement concerns presheaves only; it asserts no sheafification or injective preservation.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Tags 0095 and 0096; Modules, Tag 02N4. Canonical online tag pages consulted; noncommutative presheaf construction and universe bookkeeping made explicit by M2.

proof.text: The balanced sectionwise tensor construction from [lem-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-pullback-exists] is naturally isomorphic to the Mathlib left adjoint by uniqueness of left adjoints. At U its map is id_R(U) tensor f_U. Here R(U) has right k-action r*c=r*alpha_U(c), so left R(U)-multiplication commutes with that action without a centrality assumption.

proof.text: A monomorphism of constant-ring module presheaves is pointwise injective by Mathlib PresheafOfModules.injective_of_mono. Every right k-vector space is flat. Consequently tensoring f_U with R(U) is injective for every U; equivalently one can tensor a linear retraction of f_U. Apply PresheafOfModules.mono_of_injective and transport across the natural isomorphism of left adjoints. Empty X and zero R(U) pose no exception.

from.place: The scalar-restricted injective-resolution comparison in the field-linear cohomology argument: Presheaf extension from a field preserves monomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem fieldScalarPresheafPullback_preservesMonomorphisms
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : TopCat.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    (α : k →+* R.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :
    letI := fieldScalarPresheafPullback_isRightAdjoint.{u, v} X R α
    (PresheafOfModules.pullback.{max u v}
      (fieldScalarPresheafRingMap X R α)).PreservesMonomorphisms
